body.message:
Hello,

I own a property at Castleton, City Walk, Dubai, and I am interested in exploring FAM Living’s short-term rental and property management services.

I would like to understand your management model, expected rental performance, fee structure, services included, furnishing/setup requirements, and the process for onboarding the property.

Please contact me to discuss the property and the available management options.

Thank you,
Kishore Ramamurthy
